surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W108-S1: the contract names no refusal code for a missing, unparseable or reversed window; the adapter raises window_invalid (OBSERVATION, INERT).
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W108-S2: the 78-trading-day lag is frontier-dependent; on 2026-10-15 the 2026-06-23 partition is 79 days behind T-1; the adapter emits no literal lag (OBSERVATION, INERT).
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W108-S3: Commonwealth transactions have no event id, so dedupe-on-event-id has no key; 3,161 identical row pairs across the 14 parts (OBSERVATION, ARMED, disarm owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~O).
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W108-S4: read_rows is written two ways; on the 14-part transactions partition, newest-part-only returns 73,800 of 1,416,497 rows (OBSERVATION, ARMED, disarm owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~O).
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W108-S5: account_day_value value is null on 15,993,996 of 21,102,041 rows; the adapter passes the null through (OBSERVATION, INERT).
